title: Destiny & the Glades
subtitle: Thanksgiving 2026 · Mon Nov 23 – Mon Nov 30. Four stamps in one South Florida day, then five nights on the Disney Destiny from Fort Lauderdale.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Redeye to Miami
days.html:
✈︎

SFO → MIA overnight

American AA 1618 · SFO 9:38 PM → MIA 6:00 AM Tue · Economy · conf. HZQNNS. First checked bag prepaid ($50 each).

Four people, cruise luggage and a 6 AM arrival. Sleep on the plane if you can; tomorrow is three visitor centers and four stamps.

Before you go: check passport expiry for all four and confirm the port arrival time in the DCL app.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Stamp day in the Glades
days.sub: Biscayne → Everglades + Dry Tortugas → Big Cypress → Fort Lauderdale
days.cut: Biscayne and Coe open at 9. Oasis closes at 4:30. Today is the only chance for Dry Tortugas, and if its stamp is at the HQ front desk, HQ keeps weekday office hours.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Embark the Destiny
days.sub: Drop the car · board at Port Everglades
days.html:
🚢

Drop the car, then board

Breakfast at the hotel, check out by 11, then return the rental to Budget’s Ft Lauderdale Cruiseport Shuttle branch (2520 Miami Rd) by noon. It’s a short ride from there to the terminal.

Navigate to Budget ↗Port Everglades ↗
⚓ Disney Destiny
5-Night Very Merrytime Bahamian · Nov 25–30
Round-trip Fort Lauderdale · res. 45253279 · Oceanview GTY
Arrive within your assigned Port Arrival Time. All aboard is typically 3:45 PM.
✓ Aboard Nov 25. Destiny is ship #5, joining Wonder, Wish, Dream and Magic.

Budget conf.: Costco C509701153 / Budget 06734143US3 · $151.29 due at counter · driver John, bring the Costco card.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Thanksgiving aboard
days.sub: At sea on the Disney Destiny
days.html:
🦃

Thanksgiving at sea

Holiday menus run fleet-wide. On night one, ask your server which rotational restaurant has the turkey service, then plan the rotation around it.

✓ Very Merrytime sailing, so the ship is decorated for the holidays from day one.

days.label: Days 5–7
days.title: The Bahamas
days.html:
🏝️

Bahamas

Five-night Bahamian sailings usually mix Nassau, Disney Castaway Cay and Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point with a day at sea.

Check the port order on reservation 45253279. It varies by sailing.

No NPS stamps on these days. Enjoy the ship.

stops.via: Bags and the Budget counter take until ~7:15. Nothing opens until 9, so sit down for breakfast in Homestead first.
stops.name: Biscayne NP
stops.hrs: 9 AM–5 PM daily · no entrance fee
stops.acc: Ramp and elevator, automatic doors, paved from parking to the door.
stops.ok: One closer on the 64 national parks list.
stops.about: About 95% of this park is water: Biscayne Bay, coral reefs and the northernmost Florida Keys. The visitor center sits right on the bay at Convoy Point.

stops.name: Everglades NP + Dry Tortugas NP
stops.place: Ernest F. Coe Visitor Center & Park HQ, Homestead
stops.where: Everglades Association counter, Coe Visitor Center
stops.hrs: 9 AM–5 PM (April to mid-December) · outside the fee gate

also.name: Dry Tortugas NP
also.where: Held at this complex (confirmed by phone). Ask at the Coe bookstore first, then the HQ front desk.

stops.warn: No second chance for Dry Tortugas later in the trip. The Key West Eco-Discovery Center is closed for renovations.
stops.ok: Two more for the 64 national parks list. Park phone: (305) 242-7700.
stops.about: Everglades is the largest subtropical wilderness in the U.S., a slow, shallow river of sawgrass. Dry Tortugas lies about 70 miles west of Key West and is mostly open water around Fort Jefferson, which is why its stamp is kept here.

stops.via: Krome Ave (SR-997) north, then west on the Tamiami Trail.
stops.name: Big Cypress NPres
stops.ok: Look over the rail on the way back to the car; there are usually alligators in the canal below. If Oasis’s phone is down, the Reed VC line is (239) 695-1168.
stops.about: Big Cypress protects the cypress swamps and wet prairie that feed water to the Everglades. Created in 1974, it was one of the first two national preserves. The visitor center is a converted airfield building.

stops.via: Back east on the Tamiami Trail, with lunch in Miami on the way.
stops.name: Fort Lauderdale
stops.addr: 1221 W State Road 84, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33315
stops.note: Best Western Fort Lauderdale Airport/Cruise Port. One room, Accessible 2 Queen, breakfast included. Check-in 3 PM, conf. 148156597 (prepaid). Parking is $7/night; expect a $50 incidental hold.
stops.html: ⛽ Fuel up tonight. The car goes back before the ship.

stops.via: Self-assist walk-off from 7:30 AM, then rideshare from the terminal to MIA (~30 mi).
stops.title: Miami → home
stops.note: United MIA 4:40 PM → SFO 8:08 PM, conf. LBMDX0. There’s lots of slack between walking off and boarding, so no need to rush off the ship.
